questions.explanation: 原文: "I've never been in a lead role before. I couldn't believe it when they gave it to me - I was so pleased with myself." 解析: 男生说他之前从来没有担任过主角，当他获得这个角色时，他感到非常高兴。

questions.text: You will hear two friends talking about a café they've been to. What do they agree about?

questions.explanation: 原文: "I expected them to serve the usual café stuff - but those cheese and onion pies and salads were delicious. I'd definitely go again for that reason!" 解析: 其中一人说他没想到咖啡馆的馅饼和沙拉很好吃，还说他肯定会再去的，表示食物很美味。

questions.explanation: 原文: "I was sure I'd get loads of things wrong today so I'm glad I didn't ... I'd worried about that a bit." 解析: 男生说他很确定今天会犯很多错，但他没有，所以他感到很庆幸。

questions.text: You will hear a brother and sister talking about a campsite. What is the girl's opinion of it?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到一对兄妹谈论一个露营地。女孩对它的看法是什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: "Anyway, I've slept really well - there isn't loads of noise like at that other campsite we stayed in - remember those guys with guitars?" 解析: 女孩说她睡得很好，不像上次住的露营地那么吵闹。
